thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert INC-2001 fired - Canary group 'canary/gpu-v2' reporting repeated GPU OOMs during inference.
pagerduty-bot: Service: inference-hosting, Alert: GPU OOM threshold exceeded (5/5 canary instances) — escalation to #incidents and @alice_sre on-call.
alice_sre: Acked. jumping on it now — details?
bob_runtime: seeing rapid memory growth on step ~token 1024 for long-context prompts. KV cache not being trimmed after streaming responses.
bob_runtime: tail of kube logs from pod canary-gpu-v2-3: 
```
E0420 14:22:01.123 main.cpp:402] Alloc failed: cudaMalloc 0x7f... size=1.2G
2026-04-20T14:22:01Z OOM on device 0, process inference-worker (pid 3245)
Stack: at runtime::alloc -> attention::kv_update -> kv_cache::append
```
carol_ml: Noted. This is the new attention cache eviction change from patchset 3b2a that rolled in this morning, might not be interacting with very long context.
dana_prod: Quick customer impact check — any 5xxs surfaced in the API tier?
erin_sre: I see ~120 5xxs over last 3m from canary region; upstream routing has fallback to older model but not for some pinned customers (acct-ACME-inc).
alice_sre: OK — mitigation plan: 1) Pause canary rollout; 2) Trigger rollback to previous revision for canary pods; 3) Hotfix kv eviction config and run new canary. Can someone run the pause/rollback?
bob_runtime: Running kubectl here. Command: 
```
kubectl -n inference rollout pause deployment/canary-gpu-v2 && kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/canary-gpu-v2 --to-revision=14
```
bob_runtime: Executed. Pods are terminating, new pods from revision 14 coming up.
carol_ml: Can we reduce batch size and max_length as immediate mitigation on the canary group instead of full rollback? Might reduce cost of rollback for customers.
alice_sre: We already have 5/5 OOMs; pause and undo is safest to restore stability. We'll do a controlled config change in 30m with reduced kv cache window.
dana_prod: Notifying account team for acct-ACME-inc (low-latency chat). ETA for rollback completion?
erin_sre: New revision pods reporting READY=3/3 within 40s on two nodes. Healthchecks green in the canary endpoint. 5xx spike trending down.
alice_sre: Marking incident as mitigation in progress. Creating short postmortem flag.
bob_runtime: Saved heap profile and kv-cache stats: 
```
kv_cache_entries: 1.2M
avg_entry_size: 188 bytes
estimated_gpu_mem: 1.1GB
```
carol_ml: This suggests runaway growth for very long prompts. We should add a hard cap on kv entries per request (default 512 -> set 256) and add eviction hooks. I'll raise a PR with tests.
dana_prod: Customer impact: acct-ACME-inc experienced degraded responses for ~2.5 minutes, ~8 requests failed, routed to fallback model for 60% of those. No data exfil or errors beyond increased latency.
alice_sre: Good. Triage severity: SEV-2 (partial customer impact, rapid rollback mitigated).
erin_sre: Reassigning on-call: handing off to @carol_ml for follow-up code fix and to @bob_runtime to verify rollout scripts.
carol_ml: I'll own the follow-up. ETA for patch and canary retest ~3 hours. Will include load test with synthetic long-context traces.
alice_sre: Adding timeline to incident doc and will close this thread once postmortem draft is up. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2001 status: acknowledged -> mitigated.
alice_sre: Closing the active pager, leaving postmortem assignment to @carol_ml.
